caseNameFull: Jones, Superintendent, Missouri Training Center for Men at Moberly v. Thomas

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 488 U. S. 1003.] Motion of Criminal Justice Legal Foundation for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of the Acting Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument denied.
